findings.text: tests/standard_names/test_services_root_at_owner.py:56 non-blocking: the test declares no @pytest.mark.timeout, so it runs under the project-wide 30 s ceiling in pyproject.toml:1082 while spawning a fresh interpreter that imports the whole graph facade; it measured about 17 s of call+setup at rest, and the sibling probe tests/standard_names/test_pool_registry_imports.py:31 declares a 300 s timeout for exactly this contention reason, so this guard will flake rather than report a regression on a loaded node.

manifest.md:13 non-blocking: measurement_module records the worker worktree's graph_foundation.py, and every gate log's '# module:' header line repeats that worktree path even though the gate ran from the archive tree named in the same log's '# cwd:' and '# tree:' lines; negative-control-main.log's trailing line does record the tree-resolved module, so the provenance line the manifest carries is not the module the gate actually imported.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_services_root_at_owner.py:61 asserts the subprocess exit code is 0, which the main-tree control shows reddens (exit 3) when the lazy install is absent, but the test declares no per-test timeout against pyproject.toml:1082's 30 s default while its probe boots a fresh interpreter.
justifications.evidence: negative-control-main.log records 1 failed / EXIT=1 at abb08fa730 with 'the reader refused: Graph services are not wired; import graph_ops first', and baseline-main.log/head.log summaries are 52 failed, 8470 passed and 52 failed, 8471 passed with an empty failure-id delta computed from the two id files.
justifications.fit: The fresh-interpreter subprocess probe follows the existing pattern in tests/standard_names/test_pool_registry_imports.py, and the new names carry no plan labels or version suffixes.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_foundation.py:73 makes get_services() install the composition root on first read, so every reader that goes through the owner is wired regardless of which entrypoint imported first, and export.py's per-caller install is removed.
justifications.reuse: The lazy-install logic was moved out of services_for_call() and into its owner get_services() at graph_foundation.py:73-87, with services_for_call() delegating rather than duplicating, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in abb08fa730..f39a37bd84a8 (graph_foundation.py, export.py, tests/standard_names/test_services_root_at_owner.py, the evidence fragment) is inside the four used entries of the manifest's declared write paths, and the declared figures directory is simply unused.
